composition.serve_who: This sheet is the "230V AC AFT DISTRIBUTION PANEL" (GMMS 108'-102a). It is a distribution/load panel serving numerous distinct aft-zone galley appliances, outlet groups and misc loads, each fed from its own breaker off three earth-leakage-protected supply inputs (AFT OUTLETS, GALLEY 1, GALLEY 2). Each load-row names its own equipment per the class rule; the panel/bus structure itself is infrastructure belonging to this AFT distribution panel, not to any single load.

functions.dry_data: Fed via Q1, 32A breaker, from GALLEY 1 earth-leakage-protected input.

facts: Panel receives three separate 230V AC inputs: AFT OUTLETS, GALLEY 1, GALLEY 2, each rated 16/16A on incoming breakers and each protected by its own earth-leakage (RCD) device (Earth Leakage 1/2/3 respectively).
Earth Leakage 1 (AFT OUTLETS) supplies breakers Q10, Q15, Q16, Q17 per measured netlist (net6/net7).
Earth Leakage 2 (GALLEY 1) supplies breakers Q1-Q9 area per measured netlist (net4/net5).

Earth Leakage 3 (GALLEY 2) shares bus ties with Earth Leakage 2/1 per netlist (net12/net13/net618/net619/net620) — exact downstream breaker split for GALLEY 2 not clearly separated in netlist beyond shared ties with EL1/EL3.
17 breaker ways total (Q1-Q17); Q15 and Q16 are unlabelled/spare ways (no load name printed) — per spare-ways rule, these are spare for future installation, not uncertainties.
This is the AFT distribution panel hub; individual load rows are composed to their own equipment nodes above per the class rule (each row names its own equipment).

cross_references.what: Diving Compressor load (Q8, 16A) — glossary maps AIR COMPRESSOR -> 575-pneumatic-system, but this appears to be a distinct 'diving' air compressor for scuba, not the pneumatic companionway system; no register node clearly fits a dive air compressor.

good_to_have: Exact earth-leakage RCD trip ratings for Earth Leakage 1/2/3 not printed/legible — capture at inspection if needed.
Breaker part numbers/manufacturer not shown — function and rating are what matters.
uncertainties: Diving Compressor (fed via Q8, 16A): no register node clearly matches a scuba/diving air compressor (distinct from 575-pneumatic-system companionway air compressor) — engineer to confirm correct node or that one should be created.

GALLEY 2 (Earth Leakage 3) downstream breaker allocation is not clearly separated from GALLEY 1/AFT OUTLETS in the measured netlist beyond shared tie nets (net12/net13/net618-620) — which specific breakers draw from GALLEY 2 alone is not established on this sheet.
Zip Water Dispenser's internal switch contact (ZIP_WD_switch / switch_contact) shows a CONFLICT: printed symbol reads NC but measured wiring shows NO — engineer should confirm actual contact state.
Q15 and Q16 breaker ways print no load label ('/' only) — treated as spare ways per rule, but if a load was intended and omitted from the drawing, confirm with engineer.
discarded_as_clutter: Title block repeat of DWG No./TITLE/DATE/DRAWN — meta, not equipment data.
Legend/table restating breaker->load pairs already captured in equipment functions.
Unbound stray labels '2, 2, 5, 6' and repeated 'AFT OUTLETS' fragment — orphan netlist labels not tied to any conductor, discarded per extraction-meta rule.
'230V AC AFT DISTRIBUTION PANEL' title text — sheet title, not equipment.
